entityDescription:
VEO Partners GmbH is a consultancy and analytics company founded in 2024 by senior experts (Germany/Austria) spanning (re)insurance risk analysis & modelling, geoinformatics, Earth observation, forestry/agroforestry, and ESG compliance, currently employing 7 people. Our mission is to make climate- and nature-related risks measurable and actionable by applying our “Verify, Evaluate, Orientate” methodology across data, decisions, and implementation.
Our primary focus has been business consultancy for importers and traders of agricultural commodities and timber, helping them optimize supply chains and adapt to the stringent requirements of the EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR). Our key clients operate in the forestry and wood-processing industries as well as in food production and commodity importing, including coffee and cocoa. Sustainability, resilience, and legal compliance are core values underpinning all our business solutions.
By combining state-of-the-art technological innovation with deep industry expertise, we help our clients not only meet regulatory requirements but also design sustainable and future-proof business processes.
VEO Partners stands for practical, efficient solutions that strengthen companies’ development and help address the global challenges posed by climate change in affected sectors.

entityDescription:
Founded in 1900, the Bernhard Nocht Institute for Tropical Medicine (BNITM), originally a department of the Hamburg Health Authority, has been an independent, non-profit research institution in the form of a foundation under public law based in the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg since 2008. In accordance with the purpose of the foundation, the BNITM is dedicated to research, teaching, training and further education as well as counselling and care in the field of tropical diseases and emerging infectious diseases.
The institute combines modern laboratory research on the biology of pathogens, their reservoirs and vectors with clinical research on the pathophysiology, epidemiology and disease control of tropical diseases in endemic areas. Current foci are malaria, worm infections and other parasitoses as well as diseases caused by arboviruses and haemorrhagic fever viruses, and the development of new diagnostics. For the handling of highly pathogenic pathogens and infected insects, the Institute has laboratories of the highest biological safety (BSL-3, BSL-4) as well as a safety insectarium (BSL-3).

entityDescription:
Founded in 2023, the Gulbenkian Institute for Molecular Medicine (GIMM) is a pioneering Portuguese private research foundation with an ambitious vision for fundamental scientific exploration and its profound impact on global health and well-being.
GIMM is dedicated to unraveling the fundamental mysteries of life and aims to be at the forefront of transdisciplinary research. From the beginning, GIMM has strived for scientific excellence and societal impact, driving the future of molecular medicine for a healthier world.
GIMM was born from the merger of two leading research institutes: Instituto de Medicina Molecular João Lobo Antunes (iMM) and Instituto Gulbenkian de Ciência (IGC). This strategic union combines both institutes’ strengths, expertise and resources, enhancing our research capabilities and fostering synergies to address complex scientific challenges.

Our Vision
To create a globally leading scientific research institute that will generate multi- and cross-disciplinary knowledge to answer fundamental questions of biology and human health in a fast-evolving environment. All while developing solutions to improve health outcomes and promote local and global health equity.
An integral part of this mission is a lasting commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion, reflected in our work and within our community.

Our Mission
At the Gulbenkian Institute for Molecular Medicine (GIMM), our mission is anchored in scientific excellence and societal impact, structured around five key pillars:
Challenging Frontier Science
We will promote curiosity-driven research and interdisciplinary collaboration, leveraging cutting-edge technologies. By recruiting top talent through international calls and hosting renowned programs, we will increase GIMM’s global visibility and attract the brightest minds.
Boosting Health Outcomes
We will bridge the gap between discovery and application through translational and clinical studies. We will engage diverse stakeholders to pioneer innovative, data-driven solutions to enhance global health outcomes and promote equity.
Fostering Innovation & Translation
We will prioritize translating scientific advancements into practical applications for disease prevention, diagnosis, and treatment, driving healthcare innovation.
Nurturing the Next Generation
We will nurture the next generation of scientists through innovative training programs and career development support, empowering individuals from diverse backgrounds to excel in transdisciplinary research.
Beyond GIMM walls
We will shape the national and European R&D landscape through collaboration, promote excellence in research and training, and engage society in scientific and cultural development.

entityName: Fondazione GAL Hassin - Centro Internazionale per le Scienze Astronomiche - Isnello
entityDescription:
The GAL Hassin Foundation carries on educational and research activities in the astronomical field through its astronomical center located in Isnello, Sicily, which was inaugurated in 2016.
The center offers a 10-meters digital planetarium, a museum of meteorites and terrestrial rocks and an external area with sundials and solar calendars. In addition, the GAL Hassin astronomical center is equipped with a 40cm aperture,f/D=3.8 robotic telescope (the Galhassin Robotic Telescope – GRT, MPC Code L34), extensively used since 2019 to perform astrometric and photometric characterization of Solar System’s minor bodies, space debris and artificial satellites.
The research capabilities of the center are going to significantly increase in 2025 thanks to a 1m aperture, f/D=2.1 prime focus telescope, built by Officina Stellare: the Wide-field Mufara Telescope (WMT, MPC Code M57).

entityDescription: Safetytech Accelerator is the first dedicated technology accelerator focused exclusively on addressing the unique challenges of safety-critical industries and critical infrastructure. Established by Lloyd’s Register in 2018 and becoming an autonomous entity in 2021, its mission is to enhance safety, efficiency, and sustainability through the adoption of cutting-edge technologies. The Accelerator offers a range of services, including strategic innovation advisory, solution scouting and piloting, corporate innovation labs, and industry-wide initiatives. These services are designed to help organizations in sectors such as maritime, energy, and construction navigate complex operational challenges with practical, high-impact solutions. Notable programs include the Methane Abatement in Maritime Innovation Initiative (MAMII), the Cargo Fire and Loss Innovation Initiative (CFLII), and the Industrial Safetytech Regulatory Sandbox (ISRS). These initiatives bring together industry stakeholders to develop and implement technologies that address critical safety and environmental issues. Through collaboration with over 600 tech companies and the launch of more than 45 innovation challenges, Safetytech Accelerator has facilitated over 50 technology pilots and feasibility studies, demonstrating a proven pathway to impactful innovation.

description:
From high- and ultra-precision manufacturing to optical coatings and digitalization, this is where innovation begins! RhySearch, the Rhine Valley Research and Innovation Centre, is a partner of industry as well as academia and carries out research as a service to initiate high-tech projects. RhySearch has a technical infrastructure that is unique in Switzerland:
The Ultra-Precision Manufacturing Lab has expertise ranging from high-performance milling and diamond turning to laser micro-machining of steels, non-ferrous metals, ceramics and hard metals. 
The Optical Coating and Characterization Lab offers innovative solutions along the optical manufacturing chain from design and production to the characterization of complex, high-quality optical coatings. 
RhySearch works closely with its cooperation partners OST - Ostschweizer Fachhochschule, Empa, inspire AG, the University of Liechtenstein and the Swiss Innovation Park Ost. It is recognized by Innosuisse, the Swiss Agency for Innovation, as a research institution eligible for funding.

ChargeRevive is an innovative startup dedicated to spearheading the AI-powered energy transition towards a sustainable and circular battery supply chain. Recognising the pivotal challenges in the sustainable energy sector, such as the need for efficient battery operation and recycling systems, and the imperative of establishing closed-loop supply chains, we focus on delivering novel solutions for decarbonisation and net zero ambitions.
Our company provide battery system operational excellence and circular supply chain across the ecosystem by leveraging cutting-edge technologies, including AI, IoT, Digital Twin. This enhances safety, sustainability, resilience and operational efficiency. Additionally, our AI-as-a-Service, pioneering consultancy, and network-building efforts promote the development of ecosystems for green energy harvesting, energy storage circular supply chain, and sustainable operations.
We aspire to lead the charge in environmental sustainability by addressing key gaps in battery operational management and promoting innovation in battery recycling and reuse. With ambitions to become a global leader in sustainable energy, we aim to build a robust network of partnerships, drive technological advancements, and set new standards for excellence in the energy transition sector.
